input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves Content Creator, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including term relationships, posts, admin user details, post tag. The platform provides capabilities for dynamic access decision manager, restful access denied handler, dynamic security. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Content Creator, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage term relationships records, so that I can track and organize term relationships data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage posts records, so that I can track and organize posts data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage admin user details records, so that I can track and organize admin user details data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage post tag records, so that I can track and organize post tag data effectively.
